route_scope: Source-bound work-local route only; no candidate delivery, CVW admission, integration, acceptance, rights, release, or publication.
required_checks: Verify the exact retained member path, byte length, SHA-256, ThML root, and all ten ordered direct div1 carriers against the work-local selection.
Independently enumerate every selected element and compare source path, native id, source tag, and exact source attributes with the candidate source-accountability features.
Verify deterministic one-to-one TEI xml:id mapping, source preorder, element mapping, exact text and tail values, child order, comments, document shell, and TEI P5 schema validity.
Verify the complete source-envelope census, head metadata inventory, retained source claims, and unresolved question set.
Reject omission, duplication, reordering, source-accountability drift, metadata mutation, region mutation, and source-derived heading invention or loss.
Reproduce route output in a second clean process with byte-identical non-manifest members.
Verify supported metadata evidence for the catalog subject without mutating shared metadata or project state.
Derive a no-write WorkCatalog route and verify the governed catalog file is unchanged.
Open native exact source/TEI pairs in CVW for opening, middle, and ending carriers and retain visual inspection evidence.
source_attributes: Full original attribute names and values remain in source-accountability.features even when represented through a TEI attribute or retained only in accounting.
identity_and_rights: Header metadata remains source evidence. No unsupported work, part, form, edition, witness, print date, rights clearance, human acceptance, release, or publication claim may be added.
determinism: The producer returns exactly the five non-manifest package members and must produce byte-identical in-memory members for unchanged authorities.
integration_boundary: The shared reconstruction contract may consume the work-specific callable, but candidate delivery remains nonaccepted; WorkCatalog is derived with no write, and CVW evidence is observational only.
